## Featured Projects

### Groundly
Local-first academic knowledge base and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for autonomous AI agent integration. Indexes lecture materials locally to provide verifiable semantic search, active recall generation, and automated cross-host study tracking. Built as a Bachelor's thesis project.

### EchoCare
Safety-check system for seniors living alone, built by a 4-person team and live on Railway staging and production. Twilio check-in calls detect alarm phrases and open incidents for a dispatch team's Kanban board (open / in progress / resolved), refreshed every 15 s. Medics register seniors via a four-step Android flow that records consent as an auditable history (withdrawals append, never overwrite), backed by a FastAPI/PostgreSQL service with 194 tests.

### gemm-bench
High-performance dense matrix multiplication (GEMM) benchmarking suite and compute exploration pipeline. Evaluates cache efficiency, data locality, and throughput across CPU multi-threading and GPU hardware accelerators, paired with an interactive performance visualization dashboard.

### Vibecodium
Collaborative browser-based IDE with real-time multi-user editing via Yjs CRDT, an AI coding agent with SSE streaming, sandboxed Docker execution, GitHub integration, and one-click Vercel deployments. Built with the BHVR stack (Bun, Hono, Vite, React). iTEC 2026 hackathon first-place project.
